title: 第12章 斩仙天宫的雕像第13章 斩仙刀
lines: 封仙道界斩仙域斩仙天宫
斩仙天宫位于斩仙域中央，数千座宫殿主体由晶莹剔透的道玉打造，相互之间由无数道玉石柱连接，整体连接成一座巨大的宫殿模样
周围也是参天的白玉城墙，散发着柔和的光芒。宫殿四周云雾缭绕，仿佛与天地融为一体。
众多宫殿之上却还有一座半空之中的金色宫殿，金色宫殿顶部有一座巨大的法阵，自上而下笼罩了所有宫殿。
周岐走在天宫里面，映入眼中还有无数小型宫殿，但也有千米之高，街道道路上也是白玉铺盖，显得高贵十分
街道上的修士全部都是仙衣道袍，非富即贵，周岐夹杂在其中难免引起其他人观望
"这家伙不知道斩仙殿的规矩吗？"
"可能刚进城？"
"进城守卫可是会……"
周岐突然想起曾经某个人告诉他，以后一定要重建一个斩仙天宫，让自己的父老乡亲也成为修士，让所有人平等相处在自己的世界
但是目前的一幕似乎透露出一些不好的现象
"这小子难不成……？"
周岐嘀咕了两句，周围突然静止不动，然后他浑身闪了一下
眨眼间周岐摇身一变，上身穿黑色锦衣，锦衣之上刻有一道五爪金龙，栩栩如生，鳞片似乎都在涌动
下方却是赤红长裤，由凤凰羽编织，羽毛上还沾着涅盘之火，走路时火星四溅。
腰带则是"龙皮软甲"，龙鳞上镶嵌着夜明珠，夜晚能照亮整条街。领口别着"七彩孔雀翎"，整个人看着如世家纨绔，一身富贵气息
四周恢复动静，周围人似乎忘记了刚才的一幕
"快看！"有人看见了周岐
"不知是哪家公子"
"我看可能是仙殿传人呢"
"我觉得应该是我的心上人……"
"我也觉得像我未来的男人"
周岐无视周围的目光，慢慢走到了中央，正中央是一座白玉男性雕像，男子偏矮，有些瘦弱，相貌仪表堂堂，嘴角挂着微笑，一副温润如玉的公子模样
"给你雕成什么样了"
"大哥哥，你也来拜见大老爷吗"
一个扎着丸子头五六岁模样小女孩从后面跑来，手中拿着两根糖葫芦，左边一根，右边一根向周岐走来
"嗯，你也认得他吗"
"当然啦！这可是财多多大老爷"小女孩提起男子似乎就很激动，蹦蹦跳跳的
"小鱼儿，快过来，你在干什么！"一个身穿素衣的妇人连忙过来，看见周岐立马双腿颤了颤，
"这位公子，我家女儿不是故意冒犯您的，求求您……"女子正要下跪，周岐隔空轻止
"姑娘不必如此惊慌，我跟小鱼儿只是随便聊天"
周岐望着女子的行为也是无奈，自己有那么吓人吗
"对呀娘亲，大哥哥也是来拜见大老爷的呢"
小女孩说道大老爷，女子也是回头望了一眼，只是眼中神色黯淡许多
content_en:
Confer Immortal Dao Realm, Kill Immortal Realm, Kill Immortal Heavenly Palace
The Zhanxian Heavenly Palace is located in the center of the Zhanxian Domain. Thousands of palaces are made of crystal clear Tao jade. They are connected to each other by countless jade pillars, and the whole is connected to form a huge palace.
It is also surrounded by towering white jade city walls, emitting a soft light. The palace is surrounded by clouds and mist, as if it is integrated with the heaven and earth.
Above the many palaces, there is a golden palace in mid-air. There is a huge magic circle on the top of the golden palace, covering all the palaces from top to bottom.
When Zhou Qi walked inside the Tiangong, he saw countless small palaces, but they were also thousands of meters high. The streets were also paved with white jade, which looked very noble.
The monks on the street are all wearing immortal robes and are either rich or noble. Zhou Qi among them will inevitably cause other people to watch.
"Don't this guy know the rules of the Immortal Killing Palace?"
"Maybe you just came into town?"
"The guards entering the city know how to..."
Zhou Qi suddenly remembered that someone once told him that he must rebuild a Immortal Killing Palace in the future, so that his fathers and fellow villagers can also become monks, and let everyone live together equally in his own world.
But the current scene seems to reveal some bad phenomena
"Is it possible that this kid...?"
Zhou Qi muttered a few words, and the surroundings suddenly stopped, and then he flashed all over.
In the blink of an eye, Zhou Qi transformed. He was wearing black brocade clothes. There was a five-clawed golden dragon engraved on the brocade clothes. It was lifelike and its scales seemed to be surging.
Below are red trousers, woven from phoenix feathers. The feathers are still stained with the fire of Nirvana, and sparks fly everywhere when walking.
The belt is made of "dragon skin soft armor", and the dragon scales are inlaid with luminous pearls, which can light up the whole street at night. With a "Colorful Peacock Feather" pinned to his collar, he looked like a rich man from a wealthy family.
The surroundings were quiet again, and the people around seemed to have forgotten the scene just now.
"Look!" Someone saw Zhou Qi
"I don't know which master he is from"
"I think he might be a descendant of the Immortal Palace."
"I think he should be my sweetheart..."
"I also feel like my future man"
Zhou Qi ignored the gazes around him and walked slowly to the center. In the center was a white jade male statue. The man was short, a little thin, and had a dignified appearance. He had a smile on his lips and looked like a gentle and jade-like young man.
"What kind of carving is it for you?"
"Brother, are you also here to pay homage to the great master?"
A little girl of five or six years old with a bun on her head ran from behind, holding two candied haws in her hands, one on the left and one on the right. She walked towards Zhou Qi.
"Well, do you recognize him too?"
"Of course! This is a wealthy man." The little girl seemed very excited when she mentioned the man, jumping up and down.
"Xiao Yu'er, come here quickly, what are you doing!" A woman in plain clothes came over quickly. When she saw Zhou Qi, her legs trembled immediately.
"Sir, my daughter didn't mean to offend you. Please..." The woman was about to kneel down when Zhou Qi stopped her.
"Girl, don't be so panicked. Xiao Yu'er and I are just chatting casually."
Zhou Qi looked helplessly at the woman's behavior. Is he that scary?
"Yes, mother, eldest brother is also here to pay homage to the eldest master."
The little girl said, "Master," and the woman also looked back, but the look in her eyes was much darker.
title_en: Chapter 12 The Statue of the Immortal Killing Palace Chapter 13 The Immortal Killing Sword
